---
title: UniProt
description: UniProt's cross-references between protein accessions and gene identifiers, in annotation.identifier_mapping for human only so far.
---

[UniProt](https://www.uniprot.org) is the protein sequence and annotation
knowledgebase. bioc-on-ice carries only its identifier cross-references: rows
in `annotation.identifier_mapping` mapping UniProtKB accessions to Entrez,
Ensembl and the other gene identifier authorities. They come from the
[cdsci-lake](https://github.com/seandavi/cdsci-lake) UniProt model, which the
release reads for taxon 9606 only. There is no UniProt module in bioc-on-ice
and no table of UniProt's own.

## Licence and citation

CC BY 4.0. Cite UniProt as [its site asks](https://www.uniprot.org/help/publications).

## Join keys

- `annotation.identifier_mapping` rows under `source = 'UniProt'`, taxon 9606: this is the path from the UniProtKB accessions in `annotation.interaction` (IntAct), `annotation.complexportal__participant` and `raw.biogrid__interactions` to genes.
- As everywhere in `identifier_mapping`, mappings are many-to-many in both directions.

## Good to know

- Human only. Other taxa's UniProt mappings are not in the release yet.
- This source has no row in `provenance.release`: its version is the lake's.
